Definition: Jaddua, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua stand among those who sealed the covenant. Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua, the high priest of the return.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Jadduas show the covenant and the priesthood side by side: one seals the covenant with Nehemiah, and the other stands as high priest in the line of Joiada, and the Bible keeps the signer and the priest apart.
